description: This file defines classes and structures related to AOTI kernel handling in PyTorch's inductor, including kernel metadata, caching, and model loading mechanisms.

classes.name: AOTIKernelMetadata
classes.description: Holds metadata for an AOTI kernel, including parameter metadata and a model runner.

classes.name: AOTIPythonKernelHolder
classes.description: Manages AOTI kernel generation, caching, and loading for specific operations within the inductor.

methods.name: AOTIKernelMetadata::check
methods.description: Checks if the provided parameter metadata list matches the kernel's metadata.

methods.name: AOTIPythonKernelHolder::operator()
methods.description: Executes the kernel operation, handling cache lookup, hit, or miss.

methods.name: AOTIPythonKernelHolder::cache_lookup
methods.description: Attempts to find a cached kernel for the operation.

methods.name: AOTIPythonKernelHolder::cache_miss
methods.description: Handles cache miss by generating and caching a new kernel.

methods.name: AOTIPythonKernelHolder::produce_aoti_kernel_lib
methods.description: Generates the AOTI kernel library via Python utility.

methods.name: AOTIPythonKernelHolder::init_aoti_kernel_cache
methods.description: Initializes the kernel cache from stored data.

methods.name: AOTIPythonKernelHolder::load_aoti_model_runner
methods.description: Loads the AOTI model container runner from disk.
